content.title: Health and wealth of nations, 1950–2020
content.label: Bubbles for 32 countries move over seventy years, income across and life expectancy up, sized by population. The chart stops three times: China's famine around 1960, South Korea's rise from 1963, and Botswana's HIV years from 1988.

events.note: Famine: life expectancy falls from 49 to 33 years, then recovers.
Poorer than Ghana in 1963; richer than Argentina by 1988.
HIV: life expectancy falls 9 years while income rises, then recovers with treatment.
